# Bundled browser libraries

Libraries are bundled locally for offline use. SheetJS was upgraded on October 30, 2026 to fix CVE-2023-30533 and CVE-2024-22363.

- SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js (Apache-2.0)
- pdf-lib 1.17.1: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT)
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT)

Distribution sources: official SheetJS CDN for SheetJS, cdnjs for pdf-lib, and unpkg for @pdf-lib/fontkit. License texts are included alongside the distributions.
